title: Mlai senior scenario production regression investigation
topic: Mlai senior scenario production regression investigation
question: As the senior engineer leading this investigation, how would you approach diagnosing the regression?
idealAnswer:
Since no model deployment occurred, the first hypothesis should be an upstream cause, a change in the data pipeline, a broken or delayed feature, a schema change from an upstream team, or an infrastructure issue, rather than the model itself

Check for changes correlated with the exact start time, deploys of other systems, feature pipeline job failures or delays, changes in traffic mix, e.g. a new user segment, a marketing campaign, seasonality, or a third-party data source change

Compare live feature distributions against their historical or training distributions to look for silent drift or a broken feature, e.g. a feature that's suddenly null or defaulting to zero for a large chunk of traffic

Segment the metric drop by platform, region, or user cohort rather than only looking at the aggregate, a localized cause narrows the search dramatically versus a global one

As the lead, mentions coordinating across teams, data engineering and infra, efficiently under pressure, and setting up a way to prevent this class of issue going forward, e.g. feature-level monitoring and alerting, rather than only fixing this one incident
